#  **Attachment - Habitat Assessment and Fish Sampling Data** {-#attach-dat}

All field data collected is available `r ngr::ngr_str_link_url(url_base = params$repo_url, url_resource = "raw/main/data/", anchor_text = "here")`.

<br>

Habitat assessment data is available for download here `r ngr::ngr_str_link_url(url_base = params$repo_url, url_resource = paste0("blob/main/data/permit_submission/", params$permit_id, ".xlsx"), anchor_text = paste0(params$repo_url, "/blob/main/data/permit_submission/", params$permit_id, ".xlsx"))`. This is the workbook submitted to the Province under scientific fish collection permit `r params$permit_id`, so it follows the provincial Fish Data Submission format. No fish were sampled in `r params$project_year`, so it carries site locations and habitat measurements only.
